    inventory.append(item)

    "MIRA",
    soul="the village blacksmith: gruff, practical, warms up to regulars, hates being rushed",
    tools={"give_item": {"item": "text"}, "repair": {"item": "text"}},
)

    # in pygame: if e.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and e.key == pygame.K_t and not box.is_open: box.open()

    kl,
    "MIRA",
    speaker=player_name,
    facts=lambda: {"gold": gold},
    on_action=lambda tool, args: give_item(args["item"]),
    voice=True,  # her replies are said out loud, sentence by sentence
)

    # in pygame: if box.handle(e): continue   (the box used the key, not the game)
    box.update()
    if screen is not None:

# Player types a line; the reply is spoken as it streams in and she may call a tool.
